title: Storm Sorceress
description: A pink-haired sorceress in flowing blue and purple robes floats above a stormy sea, holding a glowing staff with a pink crystal as she summons a massive spiral vortex of magical energy, glowing text, and pink butterflies. Below her, several wooden sailing ships are wrecked and sinking in turbulent, lightning-lit waves under a dark, dramatic sky.
prompt: A powerful pink-haired sorceress with flowing robes and a glowing staff floats dramatically above a chaotic stormy sea, summoning a massive swirling vortex of glowing magical runes and swarms of pink butterflies that spiral upward into the dark clouds, several old wooden sailing ships are being destroyed by the violent waves and lightning below, epic fantasy scene with dramatic lighting and swirling energy
